best_idea: Extend the fast path to handle scientific notation by parsing the exponent, combining it with the decimal exponent, and using exact multiplication/division by powers of ten (Clinger's fast path) for m

best_lineage.idea: Implement a fast path for plain integers (no dot, no exponent) by parsing up to 15 digits directly into a uint64_t and converting to double, falling back to strtod for all other formats, to reduce CPU time on the many integer inputs in the benchmark.

Extend the fast path to handle short decimals (no exponent) with up to 15 significant digits by parsing the fractional part, tracking the decimal exponent, and using exact division by powers of ten, which covers a large fraction of the benchmark inputs while remaining bit-exact.

Extend the fast path to handle scientific notation by parsing the exponent, combining it with the decimal exponent, and using exact multiplication/division by powers of ten (Clinger's fast path) for mantissa < 2^53 and |combined exponent| <= 22, falling back to strtod otherwise.
